recipes.name: Batch Baked Chicken Thighs (5 lbs)
recipes.description: Bone-in, skin-on. Family pack (5 lbs). Two sheet pans. Keeps 4 days.
ingredients: 5 lb bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (~12-16 pieces)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line two sheet pans with foil.
Pat chicken completely dry with paper towels (essential for crispy skin)
Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, cayenne in a bowl
Season ALL pieces generously on both sides—don't skimp on spice
Distribute evenly on two pans (space matters; don't crowd)
Bake 38-42 min. Done when skin golden-brown, juices run clear, no pink
Rest 5 min. Cool on pans before refrigerating
recipes.notes: This makes ~10 portions (20 oz each = 2 meals × 5 days). Bone-in thighs stay juicy even if slightly overcooked.

recipes.name: Batch Browned Ground Beef
recipes.description: 2-2.5 lb at once. Keeps 4 days. Taco bowls, pasta, orzo.
steps: Heat large skillet over medium-high. No oil needed
Add meat in one layer if possible
Let sit 1-2 min undisturbed to brown bottom
Break apart with spatula, keep cooking
Cook until no pink remains, ~8-10 min total
Season with salt and pepper
Tilt pan, spoon off excess fat (or drain in strainer)
Cool before refrigerating

recipes.name: Batch Cooked Rice
recipes.description: Cook twice a week. Cheapest calories in the system.
ingredients: 5 cups dry white rice (makes ~15 cups cooked)
steps: Rinse rice in strainer under cold water 30 sec
Add rice, water, salt to pot with tight lid
Bring to boil over high heat
Drop to lowest setting, cover immediately
Cook 18 min. Do not lift lid
Off heat, leave covered 5 more min
Fluff with fork. Spread on sheet pan to cool before storing

recipes.name: Batch Sheet Pan Roasted Vegetables
recipes.description: Roast once, use all week. Goes in every bowl.
ingredients: ~3 lb potatoes, carrots, sweet potato, or frozen mixed veg
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F
Wash, cut veg into 1-inch pieces. Uniform size = even cooking
Toss with oil, salt, pepper until coated
Spread on sheet pan single layer (use 2 pans if crowded)
Roast 25-30 min, flip halfway
Done when edges golden and fork slides in easily

recipes.name: Tuna Rice Bowl (Fallback Meal)
recipes.description: No cooking. 5 minutes. Keep 3-4 cans tuna always in pantry.
ingredients: ½ cup roasted vegetables or raw spinach
1 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tsp honey (or sriracha)
steps: Drain tuna completely—press lid against fish 10 sec
Rice in bowl, tuna on top, veg on side
Drizzle sauce, mix

recipes.name: Lentil Bean Chili (CHEAPEST)
recipes.description: HIGHEST protein, cheapest per serving, freezes 3 months.
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic 2 min
Add spices, cook 15 sec
Add tomatoes, water, brown lentils; bring to boil
Reduce, simmer 40 min, stir occasionally
Add beans + corn, cook 5 min
Off heat, add red lentils, cover 15 min
Serve with lime + cilantro

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
steps: Jar: oats, milk, yogurt, whey. Stir hard.
Stir in peanut butter, add banana, stir.
Seal, refrigerate overnight.
Morning: loosen with milk if thick. Eat cold or microwave 60–90 sec.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Power Shake
steps: Milk, whey into blender first (liquid at blades)
Banana, PB, ice on top
Blend 45-90 sec until smooth
